title: Summer internship programme and capstone project
content:
### Summer Internship Program
AIDTM sees summer internships as practical avenues of knowledge and learning. When students pursue job placements after the PGDM, the interview questions are mostly on the internship report drafted by the student. The summer internship opportunities focus on hands-on learning with top-notch organisations and give students a glimpse into the corporate world.
### Capstone Project
AIDTM designs capstone projects that encourage students to think critically and solve challenging problems. The projects are interdisciplinary, so students apply skills across different domains of knowledge. A capstone follows a framework: determining a topic, doing a literature/documentation review, formulating a thesis and presenting the research.

title: Student backgrounds, industries and roles offered
content:
### Academic Diversity
Students come from B.Com, BBA, BE, B.Tech, B.Sc., BCA, B.A. and B.Voc. backgrounds.
### Widely Adopted Across Industries
Data Analytics & Consulting; Ports, Logistics & Transportation; Manufacturing & Engineering; Renewable Energy & CleanTech; AI & Technology; Healthcare; IT & Technology; Financial Services; FMCG; Automotive
### Roles Offered
Data Analyst; Data Scientist; Business Analyst; Business Consultant; Technical Support Associate; Management Trainee (Digital Transformation); Business Support Analyst; Project Management Coordinator; Executive (HR Analytics); Community Manager (Operations); Consultant (Strategy); Trainee - EA (COO's Office); AI Strategies & Analytics Manager

title: Industry visits and placement report
content:
Industrial visits give students an understanding of the internal operations of companies and a practical perspective on corporate structure, working methods and employment practices. They give exposure to current work applications relevant to the chosen course, and chances to interact with high-profile professionals and learn business networking.
A Placement Report for Batch 2023-25 is available as a downloadable document on the Placement page.
